newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to claw back farm money from four member states.
newsitem.headline: EU to claw back farm money from four member states.

text.p: The European Commission decided on Wednesday to claw back 110.8 million European currency units ($118.5 million) in agriculture funds paid out in France, Spain, Italy and Britain in 1993.
The move brought total expenditure under the EU's costly Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) rejected by the EU executive this year to 649.8 million Ecus.
EU Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler noted in a statement the responsibility of member states to correctly apply measures financed by the CAP, which accounts for about half the EU budget.

"The clearance of accounts permits recovery from the member states of sums that they have paid out without sufficient guarantees as to the legitimacy of these payments or the reliability of member states' control and verification system."
"The size of the financial corrections which are imposed upon them constitute a strong incentive for them to make progress in this area," his statement added.

Of the total amount, 51.6 Ecus million concerned Spain, mainly due to deficient controls over olive oil production aid. Spain still has not fully introduced two controls which should have been in place by 1990, an olive tree register and olive aid data base, it said.

A sum of 23.4 million was charged to France for failure to take proceedings against an exporter of beef which did not arrive at the prescribed destination, and because alternative legal proceedings were not completed within a reasonable period.
The amount for Italy was 14.2 million Ecus to correct its accounting for costs of placing cereals into intervention storage.

The rest, 21.6 million, concerned Britain because of "inadequate intensity" of farm inspections of ewe premium claims. It said inspections were too few and half took place outside the period during which the sheep were required to be kept on the farm. UK authorities also failed to reduce risks of double claims for the same animal.
